title: Evolving Support Priorities in Empathetic Reinforcement Learning
abstract: arXiv:2609.34249v3 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: We identify a fundamental mismatch in empathetic reinforcement learning: support priorities evolve with the dialogue state, yet existing methods typically optimize predefined reward specifications that remain fixed across turns. To model these evolving support priorities, we organize empathetic support along cognitive, affective, and proactive empathy, and propose Context-Adaptive Rubric Evolution (CARE). At each turn, CARE generates a context-adaptive rubric by adjusting both the weights of these three empathy dimensions and their fine-grained evaluation criteria. The rubric generator is trained with turn-level rubric supervision and human preference data through supervised fine-tuning followed by preference-based reinforcement learning, and then serves as an adaptive reward interface for online empathetic RL. Integrated with both RLVER and MICA, CARE achieves state-of-the-art performance across SentientBench, EQBench3, and EMPA und

translated_title: 共情强化学习中不断演化的支持优先级
translated_abstract: 我们发现共情强化学习中存在一个根本性的错配：支持优先级会随对话状态而演化，然而现有方法通常优化的是在各轮对话中保持固定的预定义奖励规范。为了对这些不断演化的支持优先级进行建模，我们将共情支持沿认知共情、情感共情和主动共情三个维度加以组织，并提出了情境自适应准则演化方法。在每一轮对话中，CARE 通过调整这三个共情维度的权重及其细粒度评估标准，生成一个情境自适应的评估准则。该准则生成器先通过监督微调、再通过基于偏好的强化学习，利用轮级准则监督信号和人类偏好数据进行训练，随后作为在线共情强化学习的自适应奖励接口。与 RLVER 和 MICA 集成后，CARE 在 SentientBench、EQBench3 和 EMPA 上取得了最先进的性能。
tldr: 提出 CARE 方法，通过在每轮对话中动态调整认知、情感与主动共情三个维度的权重及细粒度评估标准，生成情境自适应的奖励准则，解决了共情强化学习中支持优先级随对话演化而奖励规范固定不变的根本错配问题，并在多个基准上取得最先进性能。
